Lowest confidence. Provisional, suggested by TPJV for the rating session; not agreed with ACSA. Re-set it against the ORTIA capture and ACSA's incident history.

events.event: Contractor work without agreed controls
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No s37(2) agreement; SHE file late (14 days); permit lapsed ORTIA field note: Quality check of contractor work and goods against specification not confirmed (OBS-ORT-02).
events.action: Hold the section 37(2) agreement and safety file before work starts, and check contractor work against specification.

ratingRationale: Severity B. No 2025 rating exists for this system at any airport. ACSA's own 2025 OR Tambo findings in Process Safety & Risk sat at a median likelihood of 3, which is used here. Lowest confidence. Provisional, suggested by TPJV for the rating session; not agreed with ACSA. Re-set it against the ORTIA capture and ACSA's incident history.

events.event: Emergency plan or drill ineffective
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Plan not current; drills not held or recorded; no coordinators designated
events.action: Keep the emergency plan current, hold and record drills, and name coordinators.

events.event: Underground fire pump station: injury or fatality during entry or emergency access
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Heavy grating lifted by hand, no ladder, poor lighting; ACSA rated it Acceptable in 2024 (looks lenient against GSR 5 on confined spaces, project view)
events.action: Fit safe access and lighting, treat the station as a confined space, and re-rate the entry risk.

events.event: Hazardous chemical release or incompatible storage
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Inventory and SDS not held; storage not segregated; no eyewash
events.action: Keep a chemical inventory and safety data sheets, segregate storage and fit eyewash stations.

events.event: Incidents and near misses not investigated or fed back
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Reports late (24 h / 72 h); investigation over 1 month; no link to HIRA
events.action: Report incidents on time, investigate within a month and feed results back into the risk assessment.

ratingRationale: Severity B. No 2025 rating exists for this system at any airport. ACSA's own 2025 OR Tambo findings in Process Safety & Risk sat at a median likelihood of 3, which is used here. Lowest confidence. Provisional, suggested by TPJV for the rating session; not agreed with ACSA. Re-set it against the ORTIA capture and ACSA's incident history.

events.event: Ignition of fuel vapour at fuel farm, hydrant pits or generator rooms
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No hazardous-area classification drawings (PSR-005, no ACSA document requires them); Ex equipment not inspected; hot work without permit
events.action: Draw up hazardous-area classification drawings, inspect Ex equipment on a schedule, and enforce hot-work permits.

events.event: Substation or transformer fire or explosion
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Root cause not on record for OR Tambo. Typical: oil not tested; protection not tested; no separation or fire-rated barriers between bays; fire detection absent ORTIA field note: Procedure for managing fire detection and suppression when people enter protected zones such as substations not confirmed (OBS-ORT-01).
events.action: Test transformer oil and protection on schedule, fit fire-rated barriers, and write a procedure for entering protected substations.

events.event: Fire in a switch, comms or server room undetected, or suppression fails to discharge
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Detection panel faults; gas suppression cylinders or room integrity untested ORTIA field note: Procedure for managing detection and suppression when people enter protected rooms not confirmed (OBS-ORT-01).
events.action: Service the detection panel, test gas suppression and room integrity, and write a procedure for entering protected rooms.

events.event: Fire water supply fails or is inadequate
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Pumps not test-run (6 h quarterly); diesel and battery faults; auto-switch-over untested; storage too small
events.action: Run fire pumps on the test cycle, test auto changeover, and confirm storage meets the design need.

events.event: Fire detection or alarm fails to warn
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Panel faults; sensors not cleaned and tested; no PA/voice alarm layer ORTIA field note: Procedure for managing detection and suppression when people enter protected rooms not confirmed (OBS-ORT-01).
events.action: Clean and test detectors on schedule, clear panel faults, and add a voice alarm layer where missing.

events.event: Confined-space asphyxiation, toxic atmosphere or engulfment (sumps, tanks, manholes, pump pits, trenches)
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No atmosphere testing; no standby person; unsafe access; no register of confined spaces
events.action: Keep a confined-space register, test the atmosphere before entry and use a standby person.

events.event: Hot-work ignition
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Permit not issued; fire watch not kept (30 min or 1 h per S010 002WI, which conflict)
events.action: Issue hot-work permits and keep a fire watch for the period ACSA sets.

ratingRationale: Severity A. ACSA's own 2025 reports gave this system likelihood KSIA 3 at other airports; the highest is used. OR Tambo has no 2025 rating for it. Provisional, suggested by TPJV for the rating session; not agreed with ACSA. Re-set it against the ORTIA capture and ACSA's incident history.

events.event: Loss of containment from tank, bund or pipework (spill, fire, contamination)
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Corrosion and deferred repair; bund integrity not tested; tightness control system leak rate noted but no limit stated (D060 021M 4.17.11)
events.action: Test bund and tank integrity on a schedule, set a leak-rate limit, and repair corrosion within an agreed time.

events.event: Ignition of fuel vapour at fuel farm, hydrant pits or generator rooms
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No hazardous-area classification drawings (PSR-005, no ACSA document requires them); Ex equipment not inspected; hot work without permit
events.action: Draw up hazardous-area classification drawings, inspect Ex equipment on a schedule, and enforce hot-work permits.

events.event: Major hazard installation status unmanaged
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No MHI notification or classification record; the risk assessment (5-yearly) is missing or old; emergency plan untested (ACSA D060 021M 4.11(b): at least every 12 months, whereas register check MEC-036 says 3-yearly, so the two disagree)
events.action: Hold the major hazard installation notification and risk assessment on file, and test the emergency plan every 12 months.

events.event: Hydrocarbon release to stormwater or sewer
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Oil separators and baysavers not inspected or tested; spill kits absent
events.action: Inspect and test oil separators and baysavers on schedule and keep spill kits stocked.

events.event: Site HIRA not run, or not re-run when it must be
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: B170 001M sets five formal-HIRA triggers and no annual interval, so "reviewed annually" cannot be evidenced as written ORTIA field note: Link between the insurer's risk assessment and the maintenance plan or the risk level of maintenance items not confirmed (OBS-ORT-06).
events.action: Run the formal hazard identification at the five B170 001M triggers and link the insurer's risk assessment to the maintenance plan.

events.event: Change made without assessment
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No management-of-change step before a change to plant, procedure or configuration
events.action: Add a management-of-change step before any change to plant, procedure or configuration.

events.event: Safety-critical controls unowned or untested
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No control owner; self-assessment not done (quarterly under J050 001FW 4.2.5) ORTIA field note: Risk that controls are assumed to work instead of being inspected with recorded results (OBS-ORT-05).
events.action: Name an owner for each safety-critical control and do the quarterly self-assessment with recorded inspection results.

events.event: LPG release and fire or explosion
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Cylinders unsecured, unventilated or not segregated; no installation CoC; ACSA has no LPG storage rule, so there is nothing to test against ORTIA field note: Central record of installation certificates not confirmed (OBS-ORT-03).
events.action: Secure, ventilate and segregate gas cylinders, and keep installation certificates of compliance in one record.

ratingRationale: Carried from ACSA's own May 2025 OR Tambo report (ORTIA-PSR-P03): severity D, likelihood 3. Letter and number are kept, the wording follows B170 001M. This is the 2025 position, not a 2026 finding: re-assess it against the 2026 capture. Suggested by TPJV for the rating session; not agreed with ACSA.

events.event: Diesel fire at generator
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: No fuel cut-out fuse or fire cut-out; fuel line shut-off not tested; fuel leaks not noticed
events.action: Fit and test fuel cut-out and fire cut-out devices and check fuel lines for leaks on each service.

events.event: Bulk or day-tank diesel loss of containment or fire spread to generator room
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: Bunding, tank certification or fire separation lacking
events.action: Certify tanks, check bunding and keep the generator room fire-separated.

ratingRationale: Severity D. ACSA rated this system Tolerable at OR Tambo in 2025 without a likelihood; on the B170 001M matrix a severity D rating is Tolerable only at likelihood 3, 4, 5, so 3 is used. Provisional, suggested by TPJV for the rating session; not agreed with ACSA. Re-set it against the ORTIA capture and ACSA's incident history.

events.event: Earthing or CoC failure causing shock or ignition
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: CoC not accounted for; earth resistance not tested ORTIA field note: ACSA policy and central record of certificates of compliance not confirmed (OBS-ORT-03).
events.action: Test earth resistance on schedule and keep one central record of certificates of compliance, owned by ACSA.

events.event: Competence or appointment lapsed
events.rootCause: Typical, not confirmed at OR Tambo: GMR 2(1) appointment past 3 years; DoEL notification late; training matrix gaps
events.action: Renew appointments before three years, notify the Department on time and keep the training matrix current.
